content: In 830/1427 the Hurufi Aḥmad-i Lur attempted to kill Shāhrukh at the Herat congregational mosque; Shāhrukh then arrested people with suspected Hurufi ties (Qāsim-i Anvār, Maʿrūf-i Khaṭṭāt, Ibn Turka and others). The dissertation says Ibn Turka, having just left Herat, was summoned back and imprisoned, stripped of position and property, tortured, then exiled. The page does not itself call this a trial.
